title: (fix) O3-5648: Wire up stock report submission and add missing patient/stock-item inputs
body:

If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/docs/frontend-modules/contributing.en-US#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.

- [ ] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

Stock report submission was broken end-to-end:

- The `<Form>` had no `onSubmit` handler, so clicking Save did nothing.
- `handleSave` read `report.reportSystemName`, which is not on the form schema, causing every report parameter dependent on the system name to resolve to `undefined` and the backend to receive null parameters.
- The Patient and Stock Item inputs were never rendered, so report types requiring them could not be submitted.
- The `location` field was required at the schema level even for report types that do not use it, blocking submission with a "Location Required" error on a hidden field.

This PR:
- Wires `handleSubmit(handleSave)` to the form's `onSubmit`.
- Looks up `reportSystemName` from `reportTypes` and threads it through the parameter builders.
- Makes `location` optional in the schema and adds a parameter-aware required check inside `handleSave`.
- Adds debounced Patient and Stock Item ComboBoxes backed by `/patient` and `/stockmanagement/stockitem`.
- Reduces `useGetReports` polling from 1s to 15s (refresh) / 10s (dedupe) and falls back to `totalCount` for pagination.
